findings.note: Mechanical checks at aeecfe4a: key set and order equal English (172); every value parses with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and has the same argument names/types as English; plural arms present for the locale's CLDR categories; U+2026 ellipsis, never ASCII '...'; no bidi control characters; product names (Radient, Radient Console, Team Bridge, Local Operator Community) and #general byte-intact. All 6 suggested values were parsed the same way. Rendered fit and RTL layout not verified (no browser tool in this lane).

Accepted after reading all 172 values: آپ register and respectful imperatives; Urdu punctuation (۔ ، ؟ ؛) throughout, no Hindi danda, no manual bidi controls; LTR islands (#{channel}, Radient Console, PNG/JPEG/WebP, MiB) byte-intact; کمیونٹی matches the audited switcher; سمجھتا/سمجھتی slash form is the accepted first-person convention.
